$comment: Floor-control registry — the machine-readable names an acceptance contract's governance basis may cite (schema/acceptance-contract.schema.json requires the cited control to be present here). Rewritten in the GP-1 truth pass: entries state what actually enforces each floor TODAY; retired mechanisms are recorded as retired, not live.

front_authorization.enforced_by: operator authorization (/foundry:authorize freeze) + the factory flow; git history is the ledger

merge_floor.enforced_by: the adopter's branch protection + CI checks (Tier A) or always-reporting checks + hooks/foundry-git-discipline.sh (Tier B, labeled advisory) — see docs/merge-floor.md

security_review.enforced_by: .github/workflows/btb-gates.yml security-path routing + the security-reviewer agent pass

typed_contracts_git_discipline.enforced_by: schema-validated acceptance contracts + hooks/foundry-git-discipline.sh (no force-push, PR-then-merge)

live_seam_merge_gate.note: the bespoke fail-closed merge gate (scripts/foundry_merge_gate.py) was deleted in v0.24.0; kept here so contracts citing it resolve to an honest record
